0.Refined Problem Statement: Customers are experiencing poor customer care service and damaged product delivery issues with Samsung's mobile app, including delayed replacements and unresponsive support.

Solutions.solution: Implement a new escalation process with clear communication channels and specific SLAs (Service Level Agreements) for resolving customer complaints, including providing regular updates on replacement orders. This can be achieved through a combination of technology implementation (e.g., workflow automation tools) and training for support agents.

Launch an overhaul of the mobile app's user experience, incorporating customer feedback to improve navigation, product information display, and order tracking features. This can include A/B testing and iteration cycles to ensure that changes are effective in addressing the root causes of customer dissatisfaction.

Develop a 'Customer Success Program' with dedicated support agents who proactively reach out to customers to address concerns, provide product usage tips, and collect feedback. This program can leverage AI-powered chatbots to handle routine inquiries while ensuring that high-priority issues are escalated to human support agents for resolution.

1.Refined Problem Statement: The platform's delivery module has experienced significant issues, with extremely high severity (10/?) and widespread customer dissatisfaction ("very bad service"), indicating potential problems with exchange phones and offer delivery services.

Solutions.solution: Conduct a thorough root cause analysis (RCA) to identify the underlying causes of the delivery module issues, including potential problems with exchange phones and offer delivery services. This will involve gathering data on customer complaints, analyzing system logs, and interviewing stakeholders.

Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes to ensure that new updates or changes to the delivery module are thoroughly tested before deployment, reducing the likelihood of similar issues in the future. This may involve integrating with third-party testing tools or leveraging existing internal resources.

Develop a proactive communication plan to address customer dissatisfaction and provide regular updates on the status of delivery module improvements. This could include email notifications, in-app alerts, or social media posts, with the goal of maintaining transparency and building trust with customers.

2.Refined Problem Statement: Users are experiencing issues with the mobile app, including an inability to select the student discount option and use points, resulting in a high severity score of 10 due to the product's functionality being severely impacted.

Solutions.solution: Update the app's UI to ensure that the student discount option is visible and accessible. This can be achieved by revisiting the layout and design of the app, specifically in the section where discounts are applied. A simple visual fix may resolve the issue.

Review the points system to identify any issues or bugs that may be preventing users from redeeming their points. This can involve checking for errors in the points tracking algorithm, as well as ensuring that the points balance is accurately displayed within the app.

Implement a temporary workaround to allow users to select the student discount option and use their points. For example, this could involve adding a manual override or a hidden toggle in the app's settings that allows users to bypass the issue and access the desired functionality.
